Changed app/services/design_management/save_designs_service.rb and wrote the reason down in docs/decisions/gitlab-handoff-design-upload-cap.md.

Commit message:
Halvorsen Shipping's F5 load balancer caps request bodies at 64 MB; ten ~10 MB design exports failed with a bare 413.

writes.docs/decisions/gitlab-handoff-design-upl:
# Why app/services/design_management/save_designs_service.rb holds this value

Halvorsen Shipping's F5 load balancer caps request bodies at 64 MB; ten ~10 MB design exports failed with a bare 413.
